summary: Restore and hard-enforce the canonical server data boundary so browser operational Supabase REST/RPC, Edge Function, and Storage HTTP traffic always traverses app/api/**.
acceptance: Operational Supabase REST/RPC, Functions, and Storage HTTP requests are routed through /api/v1/supabase-proxy
Direct operational Supabase URLs in runtime source fail the architecture gate
The architecture contract explicitly forbids browser-direct operational Supabase traffic
Production build runs the architecture gate before release
